implementation_rules: Cut short candidates from the locked r8 frame clock, then replace picture span-by-span with the exact component binding in this map. Keep audio from the r8 carrier or the hash-pinned r3 master excerpt; never mix component audio.
Use component MP4s for presenter and film to avoid a second crop of the assembled carrier. Preserve source frame ranges and output durations exactly at 24 fps.
For every /scenes/ binding, use the hash-pinned index.html as the semantic source and author a 1080x1920 layout. Do not scale the 16:9 MP4 down inside portrait as the final treatment.
Vertical recomposition may change geometry, line breaks and path orientation. It may not change a number, claim, citation, uncertainty label, causal order, object identity or word cue.
A center-cover crop is prohibited for evidence, model, sting and tool spans because the 9:16 window is only 405 source pixels wide and hides decisive state.
Keep one focal relationship per portrait frame. Paired evidence cards stack vertically and retain separate provenance; do not merge them into one synthetic receipt.
Reframe keyframes must be authored on an inner visual wrapper, fixed to explicit poses, deterministic and seek-safe. No face tracking, auto-reframe, optical flow or motion interpolation.
Use the caption rail as an overlay after picture layout. Captions cannot substitute for readable diagram labels, source citations or native tool state.
Inspect first, midpoint, decisive action, final-minus-hold and final frames for each short; review the complete short at normal speed with original audio before approval.
do_not_use: Blind 405x720 center crops of the assembled r8 carrier
New presenter generation, performance interpolation or environment extension
Rewritten evidence, rounded numbers or removed uncertainty/source labels
Component audio, provider audio or any retimed narration
Synthetic customer results, sends, consent, capacity or live-provider claims
unresolved_questions: The canonical episode workspace files README.md, episode.json and input-lock.json are absent under blueprint-cinema/episodes/EP009-direct-booking-recovery; this audit therefore binds only to the six issued inputs and the exact r8 component paths they name.
The specific short scripts and in/out selections are outside this work order; this map makes source reuse ready but does not choose claims or publishable excerpts.
Platform-specific caption/UI margins must be checked on the actual YouTube Shorts and Instagram review exports because overlays vary by client and device.
